openings.claim: Reciprocal confusion-count sensitivity and sampling-log coupling may improve adaptive bounded review. Counting sends record-level overall-gain/slice-loss effects; logging records selection rationale and returns adjudicated labels; each return recomputes decision bounds and next selection. Both parent functions remain intact.
openings.discriminator: Against additive counting plus auditability, intact coupling should narrow acceptance-relevant bounds more per successful adjudication than disconnected, initially frozen selection. Unresolved status remains possible; neither advance nor physical synergy is presumed.
openings.probe: Run intact versus link-broken on two matched copies, independently reset sixteen-successful-adjudication allowances. Break only reciprocal interface; preserve parents, initial counts, log fields, supplied records; freeze disconnected order before returns. Use identical initial criteria and four preselected withheld rows; log attempts, withholding uncharged. Select accessible flagged rows whose supplied label possibilities affect overall/slice acceptance bounds. Freeze reports before full-label key. Replay provisional-count baseline without inspection, A-alone counts against labels returned in frozen logs, B-alone inspection ledger, without extra accesses: diagnostic references, not independent trials. Compare these, intact A×B and broken-link views for supported decision, affected slices, bound reduction, accounting and key agreement. Include setup, reconciliation and maintenance within seventy total analyst minutes.
openings.uncertainty: Supplied records must permit bounds over existing label possibilities; remaining critical bounds may cross unchanged thresholds. Equal bound reduction, worse key agreement, or overhead exhausting seventy minutes defeats the hypothesis. Sixteen accesses alone establish no informativeness. Replay cannot isolate all causal effects; one matched comparison supports only this synthetic task.

lineage.reason: Carries reciprocal relation, rival, complete comparison, defeats, resource caveats and declared uncertain fit.

decision: Probe only using supplied records/labels. Reproduce advance only for gain ≥4 and every slice loss ≤2; reject when supported, otherwise unresolved if sixteen-label limit prevents decision. Account for every adjudication and affected slice. Provisional gain six and boundary slice loss two do not establish deployment readiness.
